item.title: Missing At-Risk 33-Year-Old Woman in Diamond Bar Sought by Authorities

item.title: Jury Seated for Trial of Man Accused of Abusing Girls, Fleeing Country
item.description: A jury was seated Thursday for the trial of a 53-year-old Lake Elsinore man accused of sexually assaulting three girls, then fleeing to Guatemala upon learning he was under investigation. item.title: LA City Planning Warns of Fraudulent Emails
item.description: The Los Angeles Department of City Planning Thursday warned of scammers sending out communications using fraudulent emails in its name. The department stated it was made aware of these fraudulent emails being sent from a fake email account, called planning.lacity.org@usa.com. item.title: Hawthorne Man Charged with Sending Bogus Ransom Demand to Guthrie Family
item.description: A Hawthorne man was arrested Thursday on a federal charge of allegedly sending a bogus ransom demand to relatives of Nancy Guthrie, the missing mother of “Today” show co-anchor Savannah Guthrie.
